author: Valerie Wencis
title: Local family celebrates 'Christmas Palooza' - NewsBreak
text:
By Valerie Wencis ,
6 hours ago
COLONIE, N.Y. ( NEWS10 ) — “Christmas Palooza. Christmas Palooza,” Mary Ann Chesky said with her husband, Ron, nodding his head in agreement with an emphatic “most definitely.”
That’s what the Cheskys call their December tradition of decorating their Colonie home.
“I just enjoy the magic of Christmas and giving back to people,” Mary Ann said.
Get the latest news, weather, sports and entertainment delivered right to your inbox! There’s another reason the month of December is so special to them.
“I married a New Year’s Eve baby, then our first child was due Christmas Day,” Mary Ann explained.
That daughter’s son was also born in December. The Cheskys other daughter married a man born in December. Even the Cheskys’ dog has a December birthday.
“So, all of the sudden we were sitting here with five birthdays and, eek, that’s how Christmas got started in our house,” Mary Ann laughed.
With all those December birthdays, it was a no-brainer for Mary Anne and Ron to go all out. And all-out it is, with more than 50 boxes of Christmas decorations, well over 700 ornaments for their 15 different types of artificial trees, 15 strings of lights for the trees — that’s on top of the 300 lights that came with one of them. The tree design changes each year.
“The normal ornament tree has garland, but the ribbon and flower tree is ribbons and flowers,” Mary Ann explained. “And then the frosted tree has the top hat and a big giant neck collar bow, and then red and white bows all down the tree and red tool, red tool puffs like flower puffs. Every tree has their own tree skirt. The Irish tree has green garland, not the gold garland.”
Mary Anne’s already planning her tree for next year. The theme will be “Wicked” because both she and her granddaughter love the story.
“I’ve already got the bubbles and the pink and the green,” she said.
Christmas Palooza is present everywhere, from the Island of Misfit Toys decorating the piano to the “Santa-tizer” in the bathroom. Then there’s the 4,500 feet of lights outside, plus built-in gemstone lighting on the roof.
It’s not just the family that gets to enjoy their winter wonderland.
“As I was putting the final touches on the house, a neighbor up the street was bringing his son on his sled, just pulling him around he was just like ‘wow,'” Ron shared.
The Cheskys say their holiday displays have grown with their family.
“When we first married, of course like any young couple, we only had a little, and we wanted to make it beautiful for the kids,” said Mary Ann.
Any December baby who’s ever received a combined Christmas and birthday gift will appreciate the Cheskys outlook.
“I made a point that a birthday list and a Christmas list were not the same. He had birthday presents wrapped in Christmas paper. His parents didn’t separate them. And it’s like it’s not his fault he was born the week after Christmas,” said Mary Anne while Ron nodded. “It’s just something we’ve always done because he needed to know what Christmas really felt like.”
